note: Written by scripts/v2/brief2spec.js from stories/lastcolor/BRIEF.md (62 shots). Edit the Brief, not this file.

brief.title: Every Fall Takes Their COLOR 💔 #shorts #roblox
brief.ruleLine: "In this world, every fall drains a dummy's color." (6 words after the comma)
brief.palette: pale concrete, sage hills, sky blue; the hero and Bitsy are the only saturated colours until shot 54
brief.colourScript: act 1 (0–51 s) · bright hazy day · act 2 (51–81 s) · storm-grey, low sun gone, colours muted · act 3 (81 s–end) · snaps bright on the twist, warm gold sky as colour blooms back; the payoff is the brightest frame
brief.setting: a ragdoll test park (owner's reference screenshots): wide pale concrete plaza in a tile grid, giant green industrial fan on a frame, tall steel launch tower with stairs and a slide, roller-coaster track with a loop, raised boxing ring with red corner posts, two blue pools, crate stacks, a stone watch-tower, park benches, red barrels, a big round spawn pad, low green hills with pine trees, a hazy pale-blue sky. Painted wall sign "DUMMIES HELP EACH OTHER". No game name, no Roblox logo, no guns, tanks or weapons anywhere. Sub-anchors: plaza, fan, pool, coaster, ring, crates, spawnPad, towerBase, towerTop.

payoff.shows: close push on the hero's face as every colour blooms back (legs, shoes, stripe, jacket, hands), Bitsy hugging his neck, a soft heap of now-coloured dummies under them
payoff.hold length: from "back" to voice end + 0.85 s (≈2.5 s)
payoff.light: brightest key of the episode (head-region luma gate G2a), warm sky and rim only, the hero's jacket within ΔE 12 of #2B2D33

shots.vo: In this world, every fall drains a dummy's color.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: HOOK. Hero at 0.0 s – face fills 45 % of frame. Behind him a white dummy lands flat on the concrete – and its last red tint washes white on *color*

shots.why: awe: That's why they're all white.
shots.vo: That's why they're all white.
shots.note: Drone over the whole park: about 120 white dummies limping – wandering – crawling. Giant fan – launch tower – coaster track – boxing ring – pools. Sign "DUMMIES HELP EACH OTHER" readable on the plaza wall (plant A)

shots.vo: I'm the last dummy with color left.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: The only coloured figure in a crowd of white dummies. A white dummy walks into a lamppost behind him

shots.vo: And I fall more than anyone.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: He trips over nothing mid-sentence

shots.why: comedy: Nine thousand falls, and counting.
shots.vo: Nine thousand falls, and counting.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Deadpan: face-down on the concrete – one eye to camera

shots.why: fun: On Monday, the giant fan blew me into the pool.
shots.vo: On Monday, the giant fan blew me into the pool.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: The giant fan spins up; hero tumbles through the air across the plaza toward the pool

shots.vo: I landed in a perfect dive.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Perfect pencil dive into the pool

shots.vo: Nobody clapped.
shots.note: Beat: white dummies wander past the pool. Nobody looks. Ripples settle

shots.why: comedy: My green pants turned white.
shots.vo: My green pants turned white.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: He climbs out – dripping. (6-frame wash – grey dust puff)

shots.why: emotion: The white dummies don't remember their names.
shots.vo: The white dummies don't remember their names.
shots.subject: dummya
shots.note: Track along a row of white dummies with blank faces – staring at nothing

shots.why: emotion: They don't remember they ever had names.
shots.vo: They don't remember they ever had names.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Hero beside a white dummy who stares through him. Hero looks at it; it does not look back

shots.why: fun: Then a new dummy spawned.
shots.vo: Then a new dummy spawned.
shots.note: Spawn pad flashes – POP: Bitsy appears

shots.vo: Tiny, pink, and giggling at everything.
shots.subject: bitsy
shots.note: Bitsy: tiny – bright pink – giggling at a white dummy flopping nearby

shots.why: fun: Her name tag said Bitsy.
shots.vo: Her name tag said Bitsy.
shots.subject: bitsy
shots.note: Floating name tag reads "Bitsy"

shots.why: fun: She even followed me onto the roller coaster.
shots.vo: She even followed me onto the roller coaster.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Both in a coaster cart – climbing the lift hill. Hero grips the bar; Bitsy has arms up

shots.why: fun: The cart flipped, and we both went flying.
shots.vo: The cart flipped, and we both went flying.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Cart flips at the loop; both fly out against the sky

shots.vo: Bitsy landed right on top of me.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Hero lands face-down; Bitsy lands sitting on his back – perfectly fine. clue 1

shots.why: comedy: I lost a color. She didn't.
shots.vo: I lost a color. She didn't.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Top half: hero's black shoes wash white. Bottom half: Bitsy still fully pink. clue 1

shots.vo: Her cheeks got pinker.
shots.subject: bitsy
shots.note: Bitsy's cheeks bloom pinker. clue 1

shots.vo: Weird, right?
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Hero to camera – one eyebrow up

shots.vo: On Wednesday, I got knocked out in the boxing ring.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Boxing ring. A white dummy's glove bonks him; he spins down. The wall sign is in the background (plant B)

shots.vo: By a dummy who kept saying sorry.
shots.subject: dummyb
shots.note: The white dummy bows again and again – hands at its mouth

shots.why: emotion: My blue stripe went white.
shots.vo: My blue stripe went white.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Hero flat on the mat

shots.why: emotion: Bitsy held my hand the whole way back.
shots.vo: Bitsy held my hand the whole way back.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Walking home across the plaza – hand in hand – low sun behind them. (protect hero colours)

shots.vo: Then I saw something nobody else noticed.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: He stops. Something caught his eye

shots.vo: A white dummy tripped onto a pile of dummies.
shots.subject: dummyc
shots.note: Far off – by the crates – a white dummy trips onto a heap of fallen dummies. clue 2 (wider)

shots.why: emotion: When he got up, he blushed. Just a little.
shots.vo: When he got up, he blushed. Just a little.
shots.subject: dummyc
shots.note: He gets up. A faint pink blush blooms on his blank face – then fades a little. clue 2

shots.vo: Then a player joined.
shots.subject: kid
shots.note: Sky dims; a beam hits the big spawn pad; the player kid appears. impact on player

shots.vo: His name floated above his head: BlastKid_7.
shots.subject: kid
shots.note: Tilt from sneakers to the floating tag "BlastKid_7"

shots.why: tension: A giant hand came down from the clouds.
shots.vo: A giant hand came down from the clouds.
shots.note: A giant cartoon hand pushes down through the clouds – shadow sweeping the plaza

shots.why: tension: And it picked up Bitsy.
shots.vo: And it picked up Bitsy.
shots.subject: bitsy
shots.note: MIDPOINT. The hand plucks Bitsy off the ground – legs kicking

shots.why: tension: It carried her toward the launch tower.
shots.vo: It carried her toward the launch tower.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: The hand carries her toward the launch tower; hero sprints below

shots.vo: I jumped in front of her.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: He leaps into the hand's path – arms wide

shots.why: tension: So it threw me instead.
shots.vo: So it threw me instead.
shots.subject: hero

shots.vo: My jacket turned white.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Landing in a dust puff

shots.vo: It threw me again.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Thrown again: a small figure arcing over the park

shots.vo: My hands turned white.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: His hands on the concrete wash white

shots.why: emotion: Again. Now only my face was yellow.
shots.vo: Again. Now only my face was yellow.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Lying still. Everything white except his yellow face. Dust settles

shots.vo: One more fall, and I'd forget her. I'd forget my own name.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Bitsy small and far behind him – in the hand. He reaches toward her

shots.why: tension: Then the hand grabbed Bitsy again.
shots.vo: Then the hand grabbed Bitsy again.
shots.subject: bitsy

shots.why: awe: Up, up, to the very top of the tower.
shots.vo: Up, up, to the very top of the tower.
shots.note: Tilt up the whole tower to Bitsy dangling at the very top against grey cloud

shots.vo: And it let go.
shots.note: The fingers open. Bitsy drops

shots.why: emotion: I've fallen nine thousand times... so I know one thing.
shots.vo: I've fallen nine thousand times... so I know one thing.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: THE BREATH. Ambient off – grade 5 % darker – vignette +0.15 – music-less hush. Hold 2.0 s+

shots.why: comedy: A fall only counts when you hit the ground.
shots.vo: A fall only counts when you hit the ground.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: TWIST. Biggest visual change: light snaps from grey to bright on *ground*

shots.vo: I jumped.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: He launches upward off the tower stairs toward her

shots.vo: I caught her in the air.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Mid-air catch – slow orbit – sky behind

shots.why: tension: I yelled the one thing dummies never forget.
shots.vo: I yelled the one thing dummies never forget.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Falling together – he takes a huge breath

shots.vo: Dummies help each other
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: The shout. Cut on the last word to the sign (insert – 6 frames – plant C) if pacing allows

shots.why: awe: Every white dummy in the park started running.
shots.vo: Every white dummy in the park started running.
shots.note: SPECTACLE. Every white dummy turns and sprints toward the tower – from every corner of the park

shots.vo: Hundreds of them.
shots.subject: dummya
shots.note: Low on the concrete: a stampede of white feet thunders past camera

shots.why: awe: They piled up under the tower like a giant pillow.
shots.vo: They piled up under the tower like a giant pillow.
shots.note: From above: they pile into a soft white mound under the tower

shots.vo: Nobody touched the ground.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: They land on the pile and bounce – softly. Nobody touches the concrete

shots.vo: Nobody fell.
shots.subject: hero
shots.note: Hero opens his eyes – Bitsy in his arms

shots.why: awe: Then the white dummies started turning colors.
shots.vo: Then the white dummies started turning colors.
shots.note: Crane up over the pile: colour blooms across the white dummies who caught them. (sky only)

shots.vo: A blue arm here.
shots.subject: dummyd
shots.note: A white arm blooms blue

shots.vo: A red nose there.
shots.subject: dummye
shots.note: A red nose blooms on a dummy; it giggles

shots.why: emotion: BlastKid_7 dropped the giant hand.
shots.vo: BlastKid_7 dropped the giant hand.
shots.subject: kid
shots.note: BlastKid_7 watching. The giant hand drifts away behind him

shots.why: fun: He pressed the Heal button instead.
shots.vo: He pressed the Heal button instead.
shots.note: A big round green HEAL button (our design – not the game's UI) pressed by the kid's finger; sparkle wave rolls over the pile. impact on Heal

shots.vo: Then he tried to hug us.
shots.subject: kid
shots.note: He runs in with arms wide

shots.vo: We all flopped over. Onto each other, of course.
